objective: Proof: a three-place knot has Fourier degree <= 2 iff it excludes one complementary pair (the NAE class); uniform consistently signed NAE-class weaves are gauge copies of the triangular antiferromagnet (critical); not-exactly-two on the weave is hard hexagons at activity one plus the all-ones state; parity freezes the weave. Checks on all 34 knots and small weaves.
title: Which knot laws are pairwise, and which are gauge copies of the triangular antiferromagnet
